### TE Connectivity CEO to present at the Baird 2026 Global Industrials Conference


October 21, 2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s25.q4cdn.com/722218489/files/doc_news/TE-Connectivity-CEO-to-present-at-the-Baird-2026-Global-Industrials-Conference-2026.pdf)


GALWAY, Ireland


, Oct. 21, 2026


/PRNewswire/ -- Terrence Curtin, chief executive officer of TE Connectivity plc (NYSE: TEL), a global leader in connectors and sensors, is scheduled to speak at the Baird 2026 Global Industrials Conference.


Curtin will participate in a fireside chat at the conference on Wednesday, Nov. 11, 2026, at 7:55 a.m. CST. A live webcast of the discussion will be available on the investor relations portion of TE Connectivity's website, accessible at this[link](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4802770-1&h=2125612990&u=https%3A%2F%2Fevent.summitcast.com%2Fview%2F8hgfu2da8CspZvFv8aZFfm%2Fguest_book%3Fsession_id%3DL8xvQJvnHR9AvpuVjPujEc&a=link) .


A replay of the fireside chat will be available in the events section of the investor relations portion of TE Connectivity's website at[investors.te.com](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4802770-1&h=883489264&u=https%3A%2F%2Finvestors.te.com%2Fevents-and-presentations%2Fdefault.aspx&a=investors.te.com) .


**About TE Connectivity**
TE Connectivity plc (NYSE: TEL) is a global industrial technology leader creating a safer, sustainable, productive, and connected future. As a trusted innovation partner, our broad range of connectivity and sensor solutions enable the distribution of power, signal and data to advance next-generation transportation, energy networks, automated factories, data centers enabling artificial intelligence, and more. Our more than 90,000 employees, including 10,000 engineers, work alongside customers in approximately 130 countries. In a world that is racing ahead, TE ensures that EVERY CONNECTION COUNTS. Learn more at[www.te.com](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4802770-1&h=2531656062&u=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.te.com%2F&a=www.te.com) and on[LinkedIn](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4802770-1&h=1350778402&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.linkedin.com%2Fcompany%2Fte-connectivity%2F&a=LinkedIn) ,[Facebook](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4802770-1&h=1263814300&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.facebook.com%2Fteconnectivity%2F&a=Facebook) ,[WeChat](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4802770-1&h=597183610&u=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.te.com.cn%2Fchn-zh%2Fpolicies-agreements%2Fwechat.html&a=WeChat) and[Instagram](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4802770-1&h=3456733020&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.instagram.com%2Fteconnectivity%2F&a=Instagram) .
